description: Full record of one game (Roblox, Steam, Fortnite island by id or code, iOS, itch.io): players online and 24 h growth (growth24hPct), playersAvg24h, momentum, reviews, rating, release date, studio, tags, 14-day revenue estimate range (or the reason there is none) and estimateBasis (Steam sales-per-review tier applied), robloxStructure (max players per server, update cadence, paid passes, creator, bigStudio) and robloxRetention (players 7 and 30 days after the peak), fortnite (licensed brand, Epic-made, Epic engagement and retention), player complaints and the number of linked viral videos. Every game carries asOf (export time, UTC), source and grade (grade = completeness of the game record (A = 8+ of 10 data points known, B = 6-7, C = 4-5, D = fewer); estimate grade: B = tighter range, C = wide range, D = very rough order of magnitude.) Revenue figures are estimates with a range and a grade, never measured sales and never a guarantee. Definitions: resource wieldr://methodology.

game.description: Wieldr game id (e.g. "roblox-2640407187", "steam-570" or "fortnite-1234-5678-9012", returned by other tools), a Fortnite island code ("1234-5678-9012") or a game title (case-insensitive; the most played match wins, other matches are listed).

platform.description: steam, roblox, ios, itch (itch.io) or fortnite. Omit for all platforms.

name: get_game

dataset.description: full radar (Pro or Studio key) or free preview (no key).

measured.description: false = no theme published for this scope: no data, not zero complaints.

wieldrUrl.description: Public Wieldr page for this game or niche, to cite or link. Present only when the page exists (games of the free preview, ranked niches).

method.description: One useful sentence; full definitions in the MCP resource wieldr://methodology.

previewNote.description: Free preview only: what is missing, with real counts, and where to get the full radar.
